units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 36b:6">Ab. Zar. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>דאורייתא א׳ דרך חתנות</he> biblically intermarriage with gentiles is forbidden only in the way of legal marriage (opp. concubinage, &c.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:2:25">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שִׁפְחוּת אחר א׳</he> servitude after marriage, i.e. a father selling his daughter after she had been married and had returned to her parental home in widowhood &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 76a:9">Yeb. 76ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לשום א׳</he> with the intention of establishing a matrimonial relation.
